content.text:
**Answer:** I'd go with the second one, fairly sure. The first one only says "S&P 500" and "ת"א-125". The second one adds a line under each index, like "חמש מאות החברות הגדולות בארצות הברית" (the 500 biggest companies in the United States) and "מניות חברות בשווקים מפותחים ומתפתחים" (shares of companies in developed and developing markets). On my phone that's what tells me what I'm actually buying. Otherwise "MSCI AC World" means nothing to me.

**How it went:**
- **Where I looked:** I started at the big heading "קרנות סל" and "4 קרנות". Then the fund names on the right. I stopped on the S&P 500 one, because that's what everyone at work talks about. Then the fees on the far left. On the second drawing I read the grey line under the index, and that's the one difference that counted for me.
- **Fees:** each fund has three: "קבוע", "משתנה" and "נאמן". I don't know if I'm meant to add them up. I'm not sure if "משתנה" means it can go higher. S&P 500 says 0.8% קבוע and that's the number that stuck. The Tel Aviv funds look cheaper. It's all in percent and there are no shekels anywhere, so it still feels like nothing to me.
- **Labels:** every row repeats the same small labels: "צוברת", "עסקת החלף", "חשיפה לדולר", "מס גם על שינויי המטבע". I had to go through all of them again on each fund just to find what's different. Once would have done. On the second drawing they also spill onto a second line, so the rows get taller.
- **What I skipped:** the line under the heading that starts "רק הקרנות שהאתר אסף עליהן דוח" (only the funds the site collected a report on). It looked like a notice. I also skipped the long security numbers and the "בדף הקרן במאיה" links.
- **Words I didn't get:** "נאמן", "עסקת החלף", "צוברת", "(4A)" and "(4D)", "מספר נייר", "מאיה". "מס גם על שינויי המטבע" (tax also on currency changes) sounds like a warning, and it put me off the S&P one a bit.
- **The company:** "אי.בי.אי." I've maybe seen somewhere, but I'm not sure.
- **What bothered me:** neither drawing marks anything as recommended, and nothing tells me what to do first. I wouldn't have closed the page, though.
